acceptedVulnerabilities.reason: The advisory affects esbuild's development server on Windows. This repository does not invoke esbuild's serve API in build, test, or runtime paths. The fixed esbuild line is outside tsup 8.5.1's declared ^0.27.0 and tsx 4.21.0's declared ~0.27.0 dependency ranges, so forcing an override would create an unsupported dependency combination.
reviewTriggers: the repository starts using esbuild serve APIs
Windows development-server use becomes part of an approved workflow
the next controlled upstream dependency refresh
